description: This file contains classes and functions related to executing JavaScript code within a browser context, including handling of JS handles, evaluation of expressions, and context management, specific to the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript execution context within a browser, providing methods to evaluate scripts, manage handles, and handle context lifecycle.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: A handle to a JavaScript object within a specific execution context, allowing evaluation and property access.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JSON expression in the context.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates an expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Evaluates a script with provided arguments in the context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JS object handle.

methods.name: utilityScript
methods.description: Returns a handle to the utility script object.
